score_scope: Failure-audit completeness and evidence integrity, not an architecture or paper score.
scope: Fresh independent read-only audit of the consumed M519 R15 three-axis logic-only DC attempt after the K8 axis exited 36 on a precompile TIM-209 gate. The review verified the quarantined campaign, attempt and preflight seals; replayed every frozen input SHA; inspected K1 and K8 raw reports; checked runtime/collision evidence; and derived the minimum RTL dependency cycle from the frozen sources. It did not execute DC, VCS, simv, Formality, PT, PTPX, lmutil, a license-server query, remote work, or any HDL/EDA tool, and did not modify an existing source, contract, release, result or quarantine identity.

k1_raw_diagnostic_only.citation_boundary: A byte-complete raw K1 child exists inside the sealed failure quarantine, but the release required K1, K8 and K1x8 to complete under one attempt. K1 may be used only to debug reproducibility; it is not a production row and must not be combined with another attempt.

minimum_static_root_cause.classification: Real combinational protocol-control feedback across the shared-state K8 service and the cut-through memory adapter; not a constraint, resource, license or tool-startup failure.
dependency_cycle: M218 service mem_req_valid/core_req_valid is combinationally gated by !protocol_error (m218 lines 274-278).
M490 illegal_request depends on the same core_req_valid (m490 line 194), and M490 protocol_error ORs illegal_request (line 218).
M490 core_rsp_valid is combinationally gated by !protocol_error (lines 225-226).
That core_rsp_valid is wired back as the M218 service mem_rsp_valid by the M519 K8 top (m519 K8 lines 174-182 and 237-245).
M218 protocol_error contains the combinational mem_rsp_valid && !response_identity_legal term (lines 315-320), closing the cycle back into mem_req_valid.
minimum_static_root_cause.independent_cross_check: The TIM-209 path names traverse both g_k8.implementation/core/g_k8.service and g_k8.implementation/memory_adapter. The K1 composition uses M499, whose response_channel_open excludes illegal_request and whose core_rsp_valid is gated only by the response channel; K1 has TIM-209=0. This source contrast independently supports request-fault to response-completion coupling as the minimum root.
minimum_static_root_cause.top_consistency_fault_excluded: M519 K8 consistency_fault_now compares core and adapter accept observations and only drives the top-level protocol_error output plus a registered sticky bit. It is not connected back into either the M218 service protocol control or the M490 adapter channel gates, and it is absent from the reported service-to-memory_adapter loop path. It therefore cannot close this TIM-209 loop.
minimum_static_root_cause.same_edge_slot_reuse_is_a_secondary_veri: M490 also lets req_slot_open depend on core_rsp_accept for same-edge retirement/reuse. After response-channel isolation, this path must be rechecked, but it is not necessary to posit it as a second root to explain the reported feedback.
minimum_static_root_cause.same_edge_slot_reuse_excluded_as_minimum: The request-fault -> adapter response suppression -> service response fault -> service request-valid cycle exists without traversing req_slot_open or its core_rsp_accept retirement bypass. Slot reuse is therefore not the minimum root, although preserving it safely is a mandatory regression target.

finding.title: K8 cut-through adapter lets current request illegality suppress the response that the service uses to qualify its next request
finding.evidence: check_timing_precompile reports exactly one TIM-209 loop and zero OPT-150 findings before compile. The loop crosses the M218 service and M490 memory_adapter. Frozen RTL gives a closed request-valid -> illegal_request/protocol_error -> response-valid -> service protocol_error -> request-valid dependency. DC exited 36 before compile_ultra, and K1x8 was never started.
finding.impact: R15 cannot produce the equal-bandwidth K1/K8/K1x8 area or throughput/mm2 comparison. The entire consumed campaign is noncitable; the raw K1 point cannot be promoted or combined across attempts.

minimum_repair_principle.scope: One additive M519 R16 source identity may isolate response completion from same-edge request faults, preserving all arithmetic, external ports, memory-port count, accumulator width, source capacity and matched-shell comparison semantics.
minimum_repair_principle.clone_new_identity_authorized: A new R16 adapter/K8-top identity may clone the frozen M490 behavior, add the M499-style request/response channel split, and retain same-cycle slot retirement/reuse. It must not edit M490, M519 R15, the R15 filelist, release or quarantine in place.
minimum_repair_principle.same_cycle_slot_reuse_policy: Preservation is allowed, not presumed correct. Before DC it must pass both legal-cycle no-bubble regression and the concurrent illegal-request/legal-response attack; if either fails, use the registered/no-reuse alternative and report its latency honestly.
minimum_repair_principle.preferred_boolean_boundary: Make legal response ownership/completion independent of current request validity/illegality. A concrete minimal pattern is M499-style response_channel_open = !fault_q && !illegal_response, request_channel_open = response_channel_open && !illegal_request; gate core_rsp_valid/bank_rsp_ready only with response_channel_open and gate request-ready/request-valid forwarding with request_channel_open.
minimum_repair_principle.alternative: Insert one explicit registered boundary if channel-local isolation cannot be proven, but account for its throughput and latency rather than hiding it.
forbidden_repairs: Do not apply set_disable_timing, false_path or a TIM-209 waiver to conceal the loop.
Do not edit or rerun R15, relabel its quarantine, or reuse its consumed attempt.
Do not cite or combine the quarantined K1 child with a successor K8/K1x8 result.
Do not relax protocol-error detection, response identity checking, exact arithmetic, equal-bandwidth resources, artifact gates or claim boundaries.
mandatory_pre_eda_checks: Fresh directed VCS/SVA on the new identity, including malformed request concurrent with a legal completed response, legal request concurrent with last-bank cut-through, same-slot retirement/reuse, response backpressure, stale response and sticky-fault behavior.
Independent static dependency audit proving no path from current core_req_valid/request illegality to core_rsp_valid/response acceptance.
Fresh source hammer and fresh launch-release hammer with exact SHAs; no R15 release reuse.
minimum_repair_principle.mandatory_dc_boundary: If VCS/static gates pass, rerun K1, K8 and K1x8 from zero under one new attempt. The precompile TIM-209/OPT-150 gate remains exact and fail-closed; all three axes and mapped artifacts must complete before any comparison is citable.
